text.en:
The name of the Lambunao General Hospital located in the Municipality of Lambunao Province
of Iloilo, is hereby changed to Dr. Ricardo Y. Ladrido General Hospital.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 27, 1979
